extracted.name: Pear & peanut crunch
extracted.description: Fancy something sweet and wholesome? Liven up crispbreads with fresh pear and peanut butter to make this moreish snack
ingredient_lines: 1 small pear halved, cored and cut into thin wedges
instruction_lines: Spread the peanut butter over one side of 2 crispbreads, then top with pear wdeges and dust with a little cinnamon. Top with the remaining crispbreads and serve straightaway.
